**About Us – Faded Archive**

At Faded Archive we craft made‑to‑order t‑shirts that blend retro style with modern comfort. Each piece is printed on demand, so you get a fresh garment that remains soft and vibrant for years. We source high‑quality fabrics and use eco‑friendly inks, ensuring a product that looks great while caring for the planet. Our designs are inspired by vintage pop culture, indie music, and street art, and we love collaborating with indie artists to bring unique collections to our customers.

Based in Manchester, we proudly support the local community, sourcing regional materials whenever possible. Every shirt is tailored to your exact size, so you can shop with confidence knowing it will fit just right.

*Logo colour:* A deep charcoal (hex #36454F) for a sophisticated, muted look that complements the brand’s vintage aesthetic.
